## operationalSchema variable

Zod schema for the operational configuration file.

Operational files define: - Command execution settings (default command, key provider) - Suite definitions with command execution details - Suite groups for organizational purposes

Note: The schema is defined in migrations/operational-graph.ts for versioning. This export maintains backward compatibility.
